methodology.engines: Headless Playwright Chromium and WebKit, not real Safari/device acceptance
methodology.noJS: Browser javaScriptEnabled:false; evaluation used only for measurement, no theme injection
methodology.captures: Arrival screenshots use the stated viewport. Hero/proof section captures temporarily extend viewport height at the same width to paint the fixed backdrop over the whole section.
methodology.axe: WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 A/AA, 2.2 AA; normal/reduced-motion scenarios only. Incomplete rules require manual review.
